# RedRouter: Embeddings

Requires `RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL` and, when the instance requires one, `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`. See
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reddb-io/red-router/main/skills/red-router/SKILL.md for setup.

## Discover

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/embeddings
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" "$RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/info?id=<model-id>"
```

`GET /v1/embeddings` lists the embedding models this key can use.

## Endpoint

`POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/embeddings`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | yes | `provider/model` id from discovery |
| `input` | yes | a string or an array of strings |
| `encoding_format` | no | `float` (default) or `base64`, provider dependent |
| `dimensions` | no | only for models that support shortened vectors |

Batching (`input` as an array) is faster; some providers cap the batch size.

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"<model-id>","input":["hello","world"]}'
```

JS:

```js
const r = await fetch(`${process.env.RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1/embeddings`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RED_ROUTER_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: "<model-id>", input: "RAG chunk text" }),
});
const { data } = await r.json();
console.log(data[0].embedding.length); // vector dimension
```

## Response shape

```json
{ "object": "list", "model": "<model-id>",
  "data": [{ "object": "embedding", "index": 0, "embedding": [0.0123, -0.045] }],
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 5, "total_tokens": 5 } }
```
